Go is a statically typed, compiled programming language designed at Google. It features garbage collection, structural typing, and CSP-style concurrency with goroutines and channels. Go is widely used for building web servers, CLI tools, cloud infrastructure, and microservices due to its fast compilation and built-in concurrency primitives. The standard library includes robust packages for HTTP servers, JSON encoding, cryptography, and more. Key features include interfaces, defer statements, and an extensive toolchain with go fmt, go vet, and go test.
